previewNote: First {count} rows, as Pulse reads them.
emptyTitle: There is no month to show until you drop in a bank export.
emptyBody: Pulse reads PDF statements and CSV exports from Belgian banks. Drop one file per account; it detects the format and asks you to confirm before anything is stored.
signinSub: One household, one pot. Sign in to import this month's exports.
signinFoot: Pulse holds only the transaction rows you import. It never connects to your bank.
confirmBody: Column mapping was inferred from the header row and the first 20 rows. Check the five rows below; if the amounts and dates look right, the rest will be.
merchantsBody: Counterparties Pulse could not name from the descriptor. They are counted in every total already; naming them only moves them into the right group.
merchantsFoot: Names apply to past and future imports of the same descriptor.
unmatchedNote: One transfer of 1.100,00 to Argenta has no matching leg in the imported accounts. It is counted in Reserves and flagged until the Argenta export arrives.
reconNoteOk: Income minus spend minus net to reserves equals the change in the pot.
reconNoteBad: A difference of <amt>{amount}</amt> keeps the books from closing. The causes below account for it, most often a missing export or money in transit around the month boundary.
noReserves: Nothing has moved to or from reserves yet this month.
emptySteps: Export from each bank app or site as PDF or CSV, one file per account.
Declare which account each file belongs to.
Confirm the detected columns. The month view builds itself.
signinFailed: Sign in failed. Check your email and password.
signupIncomplete: Sign-up did not complete. Try again.
confirmEmail: Check your inbox to confirm your email address, then sign in.
uploadPrompt: Drop one bank export, PDF or CSV. One file is one account.
declareAccountBody: This is the first time Pulse sees this account. Say what it is; you are asked once.
profileSpecHelp: Fix it here if a column, date format or amount style was detected wrong, then preview again.
failedMixedAccounts: This file contains rows from more than one account. One file is one account; nothing was imported.
failedUndetectable: Pulse could not detect this file's format. Nothing was imported.
failedUnparseable: This file did not parse with this format description. Nothing was imported.
importBadSpec: The format description is not valid.
landingKnown: Rows from this file land in the account {label}.
landingNew: This file's account is not known yet: declare it below.
unmatchedCause: {count, plural, one {1 transfer leg has} other {# transfer legs have}} no matching side in the imported accounts, totalling <amt>{amount}</amt>. Excluded from every total and flagged until the missing export arrives.
unresolvedCause: {count, plural, one {1 transaction} other {# transactions}} could not be classified, totalling <amt>{amount}</amt>. Counted in no total and shown here until resolved.
reconNoteGaps: The difference is zero, but the open gaps below keep the books from closing.
inTransitCause: {count, plural, one {1 transfer leg books} other {# transfer legs book}} in this month while the other side books in a neighbouring month, net <amt>{amount}</amt>. Both sides are matched; the money is in transit across the month boundary.
uninterpretedCause: {count, plural, one {1 imported row is not interpreted yet and is counted in no total.} other {# imported rows are not interpreted yet and are counted in no total.}} Pulse includes {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} when interpretation next covers the period, for example after the next import touching this account.
confirmBodyPdf: This statement's layout is recognised, so there is no format to confirm. Check the {count} rows below; if the amounts and dates look right, the rest will be.
failedLayoutUnsupported: Pulse does not support this PDF layout yet. Nothing was imported.
failedBalanceMismatch: This statement's rows do not add up to its closing balance, so the file was not trusted. Nothing was imported.
failedExtractionFailed: This PDF could not be read; the file may be corrupt or incomplete. Nothing was imported.
failedLayoutVersionMismatch: This source's stored PDF layout version does not match this build of Pulse. Nothing was imported; this needs a migration, not a re-upload.
accountsIntro: Every account this household owns. Once an account is registered, a transfer to it is recognised as your own money moving, not as a counterparty to name.
accountsEmpty: No accounts registered yet. Register one below, or import a statement and Pulse will ask about the account it belongs to.
accountsRegisterBody: You can register an account before you have a statement for it. Pulse only needs its number and which ring it belongs to.
accountsCardNote: A card is registered by importing its statement. A card export carries no account number, so there is nothing to register it by; import one statement for each card and Pulse creates the account from it.
accountsRingPotMeaning: Its rows are counted in this month's income and spend.
accountsRingReserveMeaning: Its statements are kept and counted in no month. Transfers into it show as money set aside.
accountsCorrectRowsStop: {count} rows on this account stop being counted at all.
accountsCorrectRowsStart: {count} rows on this account start being counted.
accountsCorrectRulesStop: {count} of the names you gave stop matching. They are kept, and start matching again if you change the ring back.
accountsCorrectNothingMoves: Nothing moves. This account has no rows in any month yet, so changing its ring changes no figure.
accountsRulesStopped: {count} of the names you gave stop matching, absorbed by {label}. They are kept, and start matching again if you change the ring back.
accountsErrorLabel: Give the account a name you will recognise.
accountsErrorBank: Say which bank it is at.
accountsErrorNumberRequired: An account number is required. A card is registered by importing its statement.
accountsErrorNumberCountry: Pulse does not know the country code {country}. Check the first two letters.
accountsErrorNumberLength: An account number for {country} has {expected} characters; this one has {actual}.
accountsErrorNumberCheck: That account number does not check out. One character is usually wrong; compare it against your statement.
accountsErrorAlreadyRegistered: That account is already registered as {label}.
accountsErrorReserveNeedsNumber: An account with no number cannot be a savings account, because nothing could recognise it again.
monthAccountsCounted: counted in this month's income and spend
monthAccountsHeld: kept and counted in no month
monthAccountsLink: Change the ring on the accounts screen
reservesEyebrow: Movement in the month, not a balance
importRingNeeded: Say whether this is a spending account or a savings account. Pulse will not guess: the answer decides whether this statement's rows are counted in your month or kept and counted in no month.
importReserveNeedsAccountNumber: This file carries no account number of its own, so it cannot be a savings account: nothing could recognise the account again. A card is a spending account whose statement is imported.
importRingChangeHint: Answered the wrong way? The ring of any account can be changed on the accounts screen.
ringPotMeaning: Its rows are counted in this month's income and spend.
ringReserveMeaning: Its rows are kept and counted in no month. Transfers into it show as money set aside.
